# Linter Rules Reference

ModelScript ships **2384 diagnostic rules** across **148 languages**. This page is generated from each language's rule catalog (for example `languages/modelica/src/errors.ts`), so codes, severities and message templates match what the tools report. Text in `<angle brackets>` is filled in from your model.

## Running the linters

Diagnostics appear as you type in VS Code and Studio through the language server. From the command line:

```bash
# Languages handled by the unified linter (detected by file extension)
msx lint ./models
msx lint ./models --format json --strict

# Domain formats with their own command
msx spice lint SensorFrontEnd.net
```

The **CLI** column below shows which command reports each language's rules.

## Modelica {#modelica}

Acausal multi-domain physics. **316 rules** · `@modelscript/modelica` · Source: `languages/modelica/src/errors.ts` · [Language guide](../languages/modelica.md)

| Code                                     | Rule                         | Severity                             | Message                                                                                                                              |
